nodes.name: Hourly Check (or Webhook)
nodes.notes: OPTION A: Runs every hour. OPTION B: Replace this node with a Webhook node and trigger it from your billing system (e.g., Stripe draft invoice webhook).

parameters.query: SELECT id, business_name, mismatch_tolerance, alert_channel, alert_destination FROM client_configs LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Load Client Config
nodes.notes: Pulls the client's tolerance threshold and alert settings. For multi-tenant: loop through all configs instead of LIMIT 1.

parameters.query: SELECT di.id AS draft_id, di.invoice_id, di.account_name, di.line_item, di.billed_unit_price, di.quantity, ap.id AS agreed_id, ap.agreed_unit_price, ap.source_reference, ABS(di.billed_unit_price - COALESCE(ap.agreed_unit_price, 0)) AS deviation, CASE WHEN ap.id IS NULL THEN 'unmatched' WHEN ABS(di.billed_unit_price - ap.agreed_unit_price) <= {{ $json.mismatch_tolerance }} THEN 'clean' ELSE 'flagged' END AS check_result FROM draft_invoices di LEFT JOIN agreed_pricing ap ON di.config_id = ap.config_id AND LOWER(TRIM(di.account_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(ap.account_name)) AND LOWER(TRIM(di.line_item)) = LOWER(TRIM(ap.line_item)) AND (ap.effective_until IS NULL OR ap.effective_until >= di.invoice_date) WHERE di.config_id = '{{ $json.id }}' AND di.status = 'pending_review';

nodes.name: Compare: Billed vs Agreed
nodes.notes: Core logic: joins draft invoices against agreed pricing, calculates deviation, labels each line as clean/flagged/unmatched.

nodes.name: Filter: Flagged Only
nodes.notes: Only mismatches continue to the alert + logging path. Clean items skip ahead to status update.

nodes.name: Filter: Unmatched
nodes.notes: Invoices with no agreed pricing on file — flagged differently so they don't get lost.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO mismatch_log (config_id, draft_invoice_id, agreed_pricing_id, account_name, line_item, agreed_price, billed_price, deviation, match_status) VALUES ('{{ $('Load Client Config').item.json.id }}', '{{ $json.draft_id }}', {{ $json.agreed_id ? "'" + $json.agreed_id + "'" : 'NULL' }}, '{{ $json.account_name }}', '{{ $json.line_item }}', {{ $json.agreed_unit_price || 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.billed_unit_price }}, {{ $json.deviation }}, '{{ $json.check_result }}');
UPDATE draft_invoices SET status = '{{ $json.check_result }}' WHERE id = '{{ $json.draft_id }}';

nodes.name: Slack Alert
nodes.notes: OPTIONAL: Replace with Email (SendGrid/SMTP) node if the client prefers email alerts. Or keep both.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO run_log (config_id, total_invoices_checked, clean_count, flagged_count, unmatched_count) VALUES ('{{ $('Load Client Config').item.json.id }}', {{ $('Compare: Billed vs Agreed').all().length }}, {{ $('Compare: Billed vs Agreed').all().filter(i => i.json.check_result === 'clean').length }}, {{ $('Compare: Billed vs Agreed').all().filter(i => i.json.check_result === 'flagged').length }}, {{ $('Compare: Billed vs Agreed').all().filter(i => i.json.check_result === 'unmatched').length }});
